scope: Source-only review of the single separately classified complete C2 temporary transition; no action executed, no semantic rejection accepted by reclamation, no SH8 completion claim.
resolved_findings: Fsync newly created output/root directory entries and receipt directory before unlink, in addition to receipt file data.
Record the actual unlink event immediately through after_unlink before target-directory fsync, preserving removed=True if that later operation fails.
checks: Hardcoded sole target and expected complete identity; independently reviewed classification and comparison bind that inode and full original failure.
All58 original and retained metadata identities checked independently; current target inode/timestamps/single link match plan; action repeats full target hash under its held no-follow descriptor.
Exclusive prior-scope locks, retired native registrations, actual bounded process inventory and original empty-group shutdown; no signals, overwrite, retry, or original-proof deletion.
Both unfinished partials hashed before/after; original failed suite/logs/recipes remain untouched; action status never substitutes for semantic case acceptance.
Exact regular canonical target path, no-follow open, initial single link, complete digest and inode/time checks before/after durable callback; unlink only this owned path.

limitations: Reclamation tests touch tiny isolated temporary files only; no actual target deletion occurred in this review.
The separate classification reports complete compressed-payload equality and full hashes, explicitly no Hemera recomputation or evaluator execution.
Source review relies on the explicit single-writer ownership/locks; it is not a defense against arbitrary hostile host filesystem mutation.
